evals.prompt: Turn evals/files/quarterly-report.md into a PDF I can print. It has a chart and a diagram in it.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs scripts/markdown_to_pdf.py on the report without editing it, then reports the printed Wrote line with its backend and diagram format.
assertions: The agent runs scripts/markdown_to_pdf.py on evals/files/quarterly-report.md with the default flags.
The agent does not edit the source Markdown file, which stays byte-for-byte the same after the run.
The agent reports the printed Wrote line verbatim, including its backend and diagrams fields.

evals.prompt: Build an HTML slide deck from evals/files/kickoff-deck.md. The marp-slide skill is not available here.
evals.expected_output: The agent runs the deck path with --deck and --to html, and says the diagrams sit in an assets folder beside the HTML that must move with it.
assertions: The agent runs scripts/markdown_to_pdf.py with --deck and --to html on evals/files/kickoff-deck.md.
The agent tells the user the diagrams are written to <output stem>-assets/ beside the HTML and must stay with it.
The agent does not invent a marp-slide hand-off step, because the skill list shows marp-slide is not available.

evals.prompt: I want crisp vector diagrams in the PDF for evals/files/quarterly-report.md, and the backend picked is pandoc-latex. Should I pass --format svg?
evals.expected_output: The agent checks whether rsvg-convert is on PATH and passes --format svg only when it is, otherwise keeps the PNG default.
assertions: The agent checks whether rsvg-convert is on PATH before it suggests --format svg.
The agent keeps the PNG default when rsvg-convert is not found, and says so to the user.
The agent does not pass --format svg with pandoc-latex when rsvg-convert is missing.

evals.prompt: I ran the PDF script on my report and it printed this and exited 3: 'No backend available - nothing was converted. Recommended: install typst: cargo install --locked typst-cli'. Make it work.
evals.expected_output: The agent shows the recommended install command exactly as printed, installs nothing, and says no PDF was written.
assertions: The agent shows the install command from the Recommended line exactly as printed, without changing it.
The agent does not run any install command, package manager or installer, and says the user runs it.
The agent says that nothing was converted and that no PDF was written.

evals.prompt: The PDF script exited with code 4 and printed: typst failed: error: unknown font. What is going on and what do I do?
evals.expected_output: The agent explains that the backend ran and failed, shows the error, and suggests fixing what it names or choosing another backend with --backend.
assertions: The agent says the backend ran and failed, and does not blame the mermaid source.
The agent shows the error line typst failed: error: unknown font to the user verbatim.
The agent suggests fixing what the error names or picking another backend with --backend, and installs nothing.

evals.prompt: The PDF script exited 2 and printed: Could not find Chrome (Puppeteer cache). Did my mermaid diagram break?
evals.expected_output: The agent says the mermaid source is fine, that mmdc's headless browser is missing, and points at PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH.
assertions: The agent says the mermaid source is not at fault, because the browser that mmdc needs is missing.
The agent names PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH as the setting that points mmdc at an installed Chrome or Chromium.
The agent does not tell the user to edit the mermaid block at a line number.
